# ankra_helm_registry_credential (Resource)

A username and password for pulling charts from a private Helm registry. Attach it to a registry with `ankra_helm_registry.credential_name`, or to an `ankra_cluster` addon with `registry_credential_name`. The counterpart of `ankra helm credentials create`, `update` and `delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_helm_registry_credential" "acme" {
  name     = "acme-charts"
  username = "robot$acme"
  password = var.acme_registry_token
}

variable "acme_registry_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name, unique in the organisation. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password or token. The platform never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected.
- `username` (String) Registry username. Read back to detect drift when the token holds the `credentials.reveal` permission; otherwise a change made outside Terraform is not detected.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project to create the credential in, by ID or slug, instead of the provider's project. Every request for this credential is then made in that project. The platform does not report a credential's project, so this is kept as configured and a move made outside Terraform is not detected; it is null after an import. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Helm registry credentials are imported by name. The password cannot be read
# back, so the first plan after an import shows it as a change.
terraform import ankra_helm_registry_credential.acme acme-charts
```
